description: Edit the Ext-KNX group-address table (the panel stores it; save=true (default) commits with KnxSave). panel = select another Ext-KNX panel first. rows: [{row 0..47, ga "main/middle/sub" ("" deletes the row), dir 0 none / 1 IN / 2 OUT / 3 SENSOR, dpt 1 bool / 2 percent / 3 float, local 0..15 (panel channel), target usens (SENSOR rows), invert, init_read (desired values), name (max 20, saved at once, 4.15+)}]. tunnel = enable/disable the ETS interface (4.14+), drop_tunnel=true closes the active ETS connection. Editor/admin level.
name: myio_knx_set
title: Edit the KNX table
